summary: Diff adds a new Teen Patti–style in-browser card game (engine + UI) and switches the app’s main screen/header/manifest/HTML metadata to Teen Patti branding with a help/about dialog including non-gambling disclaimers and ownership/source-access language. However, the required original image assets under frontend/public/assets/generated are not shown as added in the diff summary, so asset requirements cannot be confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Create original, lightweight card-table visuals (table background, card back, chip icon) as static assets stored under frontend/public/assets/generated, and render them in the game UI.
missing_requirements.reason: UI components reference the required generated asset paths, and SW/manifest/index.html reference them too, but the diff summary does not show the actual image files being added under frontend/public/assets/generated, so it’s not verifiable that the assets exist and will not 404.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/updated offline fallback page and service-worker caching strategy branded for Teen Patti.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest focuses on replacing the primary game experience and updating help/legal/manifest/assets; it does not request new offline.html content or a rewritten service worker caching strategy.
